proven: typed storage self-loss successor enforces storage-layer, rate-kind, interval, value-space and nonnegative self-loss semantics
unresolved: storage_transition and typed self-loss successor receive no topology node set and therefore cannot prove host_node_id exists in the active storage-layer topology
a StorageManifest with an arbitrary nonexistent host_node_id is accepted by the local transition
storage_host_node_scope.priority_note: Important topology-binding gap, but the local transition does not itself route storage to a different node. Selection priority remains below a parameter uncertainty gap that directly understates physical output uncertainty.

proven: capacity, max charge/discharge rates, eta_charge and eta_discharge are explicit StorageManifest parameters
their deterministic bounds and nominal arithmetic are tested
unresolved: capacity, max_charge_rate, max_discharge_rate, eta_charge and eta_discharge are raw Fraction fields without uncertainty, evidence refs or validity interval
current end-to-end storage uncertainty treats all storage manifest parameters as exact constants
storage_parameter_uncertainty.priority_note: Material model-parameter gap. Not selected first because process coefficients are already evidence-bearing physical conversion parameters and their missing uncertainty propagates directly into every typed process contribution.

proven: typed process successor checks coefficient evidence_ref
typed process successor checks coefficient_unit dimensionally
typed process output is a QualifiedValue and preserves activity metadata
unresolved: ProcessCoefficient.coefficient is a raw Fraction with no uncertainty representation
typed process successor scales only activity uncertainty and implicitly treats coefficient uncertainty as EXACT
with exact activity the process output uncertainty is ExactUncertainty even though the coefficient has no mechanism to express uncertainty
executable_gap_probes: ProcessCoefficient dataclass has no uncertainty field
an exact activity and evidence-bound coefficient produce ExactUncertainty output solely because coefficient uncertainty is unrepresentable

proven: ProcessCoefficient carries layer, node, coefficient, evidence_ref and coefficient_unit
unresolved: ProcessCoefficient has no valid_from or valid_to field
coefficient applicability cannot be fail-closed against the requested interval
process_coefficient_validity_interval.priority_note: Must be closed before time-varying process coefficients are admitted, but current V1 process fixtures are static synthetic coefficients.

unresolved: typed process successor does not compare process.manifest_version to an expected active manifest version
a V99 process manifest can currently be accepted against V1 target nodes when all other guards pass
process_manifest_version_enforcement.priority_note: Important configuration-consistency gap, but coefficient uncertainty has a direct quantitative effect on the physical uncertainty envelope.

proven: audit/evidence values are excluded from physical QualifiedValue paths
unresolved: audit_vector_l1_l4 returns a bare tuple without provenance, evidence refs, uncertainty, validity or typed audit object semantics
audit_vector_provenance_typing.priority_note: Governance metadata gap, not selected first because audit vectors do not currently mutate physical state or physical uncertainty.

rationale: ProcessCoefficient is a direct physical conversion parameter already admitted into typed process arithmetic
its uncertainty is currently unrepresentable and therefore silently treated as exact
this can understate the end-to-end physical uncertainty envelope even though activity uncertainty is preserved
closing coefficient uncertainty extends the existing no-silent-uncertainty-loss invariant to process conversion parameters without broadening into validity or topology work
